description: Build the Onboarding and Outreach page UIs — the consent/masked-inbox moment and the PII-block demo moment. Grouped because Outreach depends on the consent + masked inbox established in Onboarding. Depends on FEAT-001 (the /api/outreach/draft endpoint calls draftOutreachEmail, which must compile after the DeepSeek port).
steps: Onboarding: replace the placeholder in /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/src/app/(app)/onboarding/page.tsx (keep `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"` and metadata) so it renders a new client component OnboardingForm.

Create /Users/leeguanfeng/Documents/Github/Assura/.worktrees/jeff-outreach-crm/web/src/components/outreach/outreach-form.tsx ("use client"), optionally with small helper components under src/components/outreach/. Step 1: on mount GET /api/insurers -> { insurers: [{id,name,agentEmail,logo,website}] }; allow selecting up to MAX_INSURERS_PER_OUTREACH (5, from src/lib/constants.ts) with the select control disabled past 5. Step 2: choose a template from OUTREACH_TEMPLATES (constants.ts) and optionally fill userContext fields allowed by draftRequestSchema (age, gender enum male|female|prefer_not_to_say, smoker boolean, coverageNeeded, monthlyBudget). Step 3 Generate draft: POST /api/outreach/draft { insurerId, templateId, userContext } -> { draft, insurer }; show subject + body in an EDITABLE textarea (if draft is a single string, place it in the body textarea with a separate subject input). Step 4 Approve & send: POST /api/outreach/send with body { insurerId, subject, body, threadId?, userApproved: true } (userApproved:true is REQUIRED by sendRequestSchema or the request 400s).

Outreach PII demo moment: when /api/outreach/send responds HTTP 422 with { error, code: "PII_BLOCKED" }, render a prominent red error banner (use a red Tailwind alert box consistent with ui/badge red variant styling) stating the email was blocked by the PII guard and was NOT sent, and keep the draft editable so the user can remove the PII and retry. On 200 { threadId, messageId } show a success state with a link to /crm/<threadId>. Keep all copy factual (never 'buy this plan').
Record anything relevant (e.g. exact masked-inbox render location, draft subject/body split decision) in findings for the CRM feature and the reviewer.

findings:
DONE. Onboarding + Outreach UIs built; CRM pieces (thread-timeline, quote-card, crm/[threadId]) were NOT touched — they belong to FEAT-003.

FILES: onboarding/page.tsx now renders <OnboardingForm/>; outreach/page.tsx now renders <OutreachForm/> (both kept `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"` + metadata, server components importing the client child). Created web/src/components/onboarding/onboarding-form.tsx and web/src/components/outreach/outreach-form.tsx (both "use client").

ONBOARDING: 8 consent checkboxes mapped 1:1 to ConsentFlags (shareAge, shareGender, shareSmokerStatus, shareCoverageNeeds, shareBudgetRange, shareOccupation, shareHealthHistory, shareIncome), all default false. PATCH /api/onboarding body is { consent: {...8 booleans} }. On 200, the returned maskedInbox renders in a highlighted green card (mono font) below the form — that card is the masked-inbox render location.

OUTREACH: GET /api/insurers on mount. Insurer multi-select capped at MAX_INSURERS_PER_OUTREACH (5): once 5 are picked, unselected checkboxes are disabled (and a `n/5` Badge shows count). Template <select> is seeded from OUTREACH_TEMPLATES[0] and lists all templates. userContext inputs: age (number), gender (enum male|female|prefer_not_to_say, '' omitted), smoker (always sent as boolean), coverageNeeded, monthlyBudget (numbers; blanks omitted). buildUserContext() coerces strings to Number and drops empties so draftRequestSchema passes.

DRAFT/SEND: draft is generated PER insurer (the draft/send endpoints take a single insurerId). /api/outreach/draft returns { draft: string } — DECISION: draft is a single string, so it goes into the editable BODY textarea and the SUBJECT is a separate editable input pre-seeded with the chosen template's `label`. /api/outreach/send body ALWAYS includes userApproved: true (required by sendRequestSchema or it 400s). Send button disabled until subject+body are non-empty.

PII DEMO MOMENT: send handler checks res.status === 422 && data.code === 'PII_BLOCKED' FIRST and renders a prominent red alert box (border-red-300 bg-red-50, red-800 heading) stating the email was BLOCKED and NOT sent, keeping the subject/body editable for retry. On 200 { threadId } it swaps to a green success box with a Link to `/crm/<threadId>`. All copy is factual (no 'buy this plan').

VERIFICATION: `npm run build` exits 0 (all routes compile incl. /onboarding, /outreach). `npm run lint` exits 0; the only 2 eslint errors are PRE-EXISTING and outside scope — src/app/(public)/page.tsx (react/no-unescaped-entities) and src/hooks/use-plans.ts (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect), both documented in FEAT-001 findings as present on the base commit. My new files produce zero lint errors. No temp files created (.next is gitignored).

FOR FEAT-003 / CRM: a sent outreach deep-links to /crm/<threadId> (the success Link), so the CRM thread page must handle a freshly-created threadId. Thread is created server-side in /api/outreach/send with status 'sent', one outbound aiGenerated message, extractedQuote null.
